candidates.decision_relevance: Would let the reviews compare rebound, drawdown, and recovery sequences against the evidence available at each review cutoff, rather than relying on weekly endpoints or qualitative path descriptions.
candidates.evidence_reference: Repeated W39–W46 reviews note missing raw price paths, time-ordered signal observations, or freeze-time sequences; daily analyses also describe conflicting return horizons and ETH/BTC persistence.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped BTC, ETH, and ETH/BTC price sequence
candidates.missing_history_problem: Without a retained, time-aligned historical path, the reviews cannot verify path ordering, rebound magnitude, or whether cited deterioration preceded price weakness.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would help distinguish sustained participation changes from isolated proxy snapshots and assess whether breadth evidence preceded or followed price moves.
candidates.evidence_reference: Multiple weekly and daily reviews describe missing breadth series or methodology, proxy-only observations, and changing point-in-time membership that prevents like-for-like comparisons.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped breadth observations with universe and membership metadata
candidates.missing_history_problem: Single captures and changing constituent sets do not establish the persistence, timing, or comparability of participation changes.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would clarify whether reported BTC and ETH flow divergence or outflows persisted across settled sessions, rather than relying on one session or stale weekly detail.
candidates.evidence_reference: Reviews repeatedly identify settled ETF evidence as limited to one session or an earlier week, and caution against carrying older flow rows forward as current evidence.
candidates.metric_name: Dated settled BTC and ETH ETF flow observations
candidates.missing_history_problem: Sparse or stale session rows cannot establish the duration or sequence of flows relative to price and breadth changes.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would allow candidate-level retrospective checks while preserving issuance-time information and separating matured outcomes from unavailable or immature ones.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly reviews repeatedly report that forecast candidate definitions, issuance times, exact bounds, scorecard rows, or linked matured outcomes are unavailable through the supplied context.
candidates.metric_name: Frozen forecast candidate and maturity-linked outcome record
candidates.missing_history_problem: Aggregate counts of matured outcomes cannot establish candidate-specific errors, range containment, or whether observations were available at issuance.
